findings.problem: The hint 'coming to a halt' fits anhalten (der Zug hält an, das Auto hält an) and stehen bleiben just as well, and for a car anhalten is the more natural answer, so the prompt has more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: of a bus or train making its scheduled stop at a station (one word, not anhalten)

back.target: to stop (of a vehicle, at a station or stop); also to hold, to keep
back.example: The bus stops right outside my house.

note: parar-stop is broader than this vehicle-only sense of halten, but a picture of a bus stopping still fits it.
